title: Cartwise+ Enrolment Tenure and the Unfound-Line Tenure Allowance on Grocery Orders
content:
# Cartwise+ enrolment tenure and the unfound-line tenure allowance

**Scope.** Cartwise Grocery Orders; the refund room for a line billed although the shopper recorded its product as not found. The allowance is read from the enrolled date of the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order.

## Terms

The unfound-line tenure allowance is added to the room before the refunds already granted are taken off: when the membership recorded on the order was enrolled **at least 36 whole calendar months** before the order's placed date, the allowance is **3.00**; when it was enrolled **at least 12 and fewer than 36** whole calendar months before, it is **1.50**; otherwise, or when no membership is recorded, there is none.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old. Here the earlier date is the membership's enrolled date and the later date is the order's placed date.

## Bands

| Whole months from enrolled date to placed date | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 3.00 |
| 12 to 35 | 1.50 |
| 11 or fewer | none |
| No membership on the order | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Enrolled 10 May three years before an order placed 10 May: the 36th anniversary falls on the placed date — 36 whole months, allowance 3.00.
- Same enrolment, order placed 9 May: 35 whole months — allowance 1.50.
- Enrolled 20 January, order placed 19 January of the following year: 11 whole months — no allowance; placed 20 January — 12 whole months, allowance 1.50.

The months run to the order's placed date, not to today.
